opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 499 U. S. 974.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted. Motion of respondent Alliance for Affordable Energy, Inc., for divided argument and for additional time for oral argument denied.
